title: VTA Calendar — Settings — Update — payload
description: A client changes a trust context's calendar settings: turns syncing on or off, sets the default reminders, or sets or clears quiet hours. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

sync.description: Sync the principal's events from their communities in this context (VTI-CAL-010).

Response.title: VTA Calendar — Settings — Update — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vta/calendar/settings/update/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vta/calendar/settings/update/0.1#response.
